sloka: उपतस्थुर्महात्मानो मन्त्रिणः सपुरोहिताः ।वसिष्ठप्रमुखाः सर्वे दीप्यमाना इवाग्नयः ।। ७.३७.१५ ॥
transliteration: upatasthurmahātmāno mantriṇaḥ sapurohitāḥ ।vasiṣṭhapramukhāḥ sarve dīpyamānā ivāgnayaḥ ।। 7.37.15 ॥

translations.english: All the great-souled ministers, along with their priests and headed by Vasishtha, approached Rama, shining brightly like fires.
